title: Power Rule
explanation: The Power Rule is used to differentiate a function containing a power of x. Multiply the exponent by the coefficient, then decrease the exponent by 1.

title: Product Rule
explanation: The Product Rule is used when differentiating the product of two functions.

title: Quotient Rule
explanation: The Quotient Rule is used when differentiating one function divided by another.

title: Chain Rule
explanation: The Chain Rule is used to differentiate composite functions. Differentiate the outer function first, then multiply by the derivative of the inner function.

title: Derivative of a Constant
explanation: The derivative of any constant is zero because a constant does not change as x changes.

title: Derivative of e^x
explanation: The exponential function e^x is special because its derivative is the function itself.

title: Derivative of ln(x)
explanation: The derivative of the natural logarithm of x is the reciprocal of x.

title: Derivative of sin(x)
explanation: The derivative of sine is cosine.

title: Derivative of cos(x)
explanation: The derivative of cosine is negative sine.

title: Derivative of tan(x)
explanation: The derivative of tangent is secant squared.
